name: a read of a handle no engine could have minted is still a 404
description: The same handle delete-blob-bad-handle.json answers 400 for. Read collapses 'malformed' and 'gone' into 404 on purpose: the caller holds one engine/handle pair per file and cannot act on the difference either way. This fixture exists to keep that asymmetry a decision instead of a regression — the obvious tidy-up is to make both endpoints answer the same code, and this pair is what says no. For the local disk backend the same validation is also a security boundary: filepath.Join resolves a '..' segment, so the handle pattern is what stops a read from escaping the storage root.
